mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.user_id, u.nickname, u.avatar, p.real_name, p.student_id, p.school, p.english_level, p.introduction, p.introduction_en, p.service_types, p.hourly_rate, p.rating, p.total_orders, p.status, p.create_time FROM interpreter_profile p LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.rating DESC, p.total_orders DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interpreter_profile WHERE status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE interpreter_profile SET real_name = #{realName}, student_id = #{studentId}, school = #{school}, english_level = #{englishLevel}, cert_url = #{certUrl}, cert_no = #{certNo}, introduction = #{introduction}, introduction_en = #{introductionEn}, service_types = #{serviceTypes}, hourly_rate = #{hourlyRate}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
